      "rationale": "The alarm AL-44 triggered at 10:00:32 (supported by n-gybvj2 and fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1). The point register maps this alarm to the receiving-header pressure condition P-R, not C-11's trip contact (supported by da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1). Therefore, a drop in P-R caused the alarm. The evidence does not support that C-11 RUN status directly triggered AL-44; it is merely correlated.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-1hgfue3", "claim-u9yne3"],
      "counterfactual": "If P-R had not dropped below 4.5 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered per its logic (n-gybvj2). If the mapping were to C-11 RUN instead of P-R pressure, a drop in P-R alone might not trigger it.",
      "competingExplanation": "The alarm could be mis-mapped or configured incorrectly; however current evidence supports that AL-44 is mapped to P-R (da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1).",
      "evidenceGap": "None for this specific link; the mapping and alarm logic are supported."
    },

      "counterfactual": "If P-R had remained above 4.5 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; the alarm logic and pressure drop are supported by evidence.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact origin of the pressure drop (upstream vs downstream) is unknown per finding-1565wn7."
    },

      "evidenceGap": "Whether an unrecorded change in service routing or valve state actually existed and caused the interruption."

    {

  "decision": {
    "summary": "The focal event was triggered by a pressure drop at P-R below alarm thresholds. The evidence supports that AL-44 is mapped to P-R and triggers when pressure drops below 4.5 bar. However, the origin of the pressure drop (upstream vs downstream) remains unknown. Several contributing factors are identified but remain unsupported due to lack of direct evidence: undocumented service-routing changes, valve states contrary to procedure, breakdown in communication, incomplete documentation, etc.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1", "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Origin of pressure drop (upstream vs downstream)", "Whether undocumented service-routing changes or valve states existed", "Breakdown in communication between Utilities and RHOB", "Incomplete documentation contributing to hazard scenario"],
    "alternatives": ["Pressure drop originated upstream due to equipment failure", "Pressure drop originated within distribution network due to maintenance activity", "Pressure drop originated downstream due to process change"],
    "confidence": 0.65
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "Request the full point register (IA-P02) for May 20, 2024 to determine if any valve states or service routing changes are recorded.",
    "Request maintenance work order WO-527 and its associated documentation to verify whether field execution records were completed."
  ]
}
